title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Payable Administrator

Salary: 27,000 - 30,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-Time Permanent

Our client is looking to recruit an experienced Accounts Payable Administrator to join their finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong accounts payable experience looking to join an established business in a varied finance and administration role.

The Role

Responsibilities will include:
- Processing supplier invoices and matching them against purchase orders.
- Updating finance systems and ensuring accurate invoice coding.
- Preparing weekly supplier payment runs.
- Handling supplier queries and resolving invoice discrepancies.
- Assisting with credit card processing and reconciliations.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation.
- Supporting vehicle administration, including servicing, mileage claims and vehicle-related charges.
- Providing general finance and administrative support.

About You
- At least three years' experience in accounts payable.
- Experience processing supplier invoices and using finance systems.
- Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.

Apply Today

If you're an experienced Accounts Payable Administrator, Purchase Ledger Clerk, Accounts Assistant or Finance Administrator looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
My client is seeking an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Payable Administrator to join their finance team in Birkenhead.The role will focus on processing supplier invoices and payments, assisting with credit card reconciliations and providing general administrative support, including vehicle administration.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable and Finance
- Process incoming supplier invoices, checking details against purchase orders and ensuring the correct references and cost codes are recorded.
- Obtain the necessary authorisations and process approved invoices through the relevant finance systems.
- Prepare and process weekly supplier payment runs.
- Respond to supplier queries professionally and promptly.
- Assist with credit card transaction processing and reconciliations.
- Provide general finance and administrative support as required.
- General Administration and Operational Support
- Answer incoming telephone calls and direct enquiries appropriately.
- Liaise with drivers and vehicle maintenance providers to arrange servicing and maintenance.
- Update vehicle insurance details when vehicles are exchanged.
- Check and process driver mileage claims.
- Maintain accurate records and up-to-date documentation.

Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- GCSEs or equivalent, including English and Maths at grade C/4 or above.
- At least three years' experience in an accounts payable role.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience using finance systems and processing supplier invoices.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- A professional and helpful approach when dealing with colleagues, suppliers and external contacts.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

This role offers a basic salary of up to £29,000 depending on experience, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, company pension, death in service

title: Accounts Payable Clerk
description:
- Immediate Start
- 6 month contract
- Opportunity to move to a permanent contract

Accounts Payable Clerk - 9 Month Contract- with the opportunity to go permanent
Location: Wirral
Salary: Up to £30,000 pro rata
Contract: 6-7 months - Maternity Cover
We are currently recruiting for an experienced Accounts Payable Clerk to join a well-established organisation based on the Wirral on a 6-month maternity cover contract.
This is a busy transactional role within the finance team, responsible for the accurate and timely processing of supplier invoices, payments and reconciliations.
Key Responsibilities
- Match supplier invoices to purchase orders and goods receipts
- Check prices, quantities, VAT and invoice validity.
- Obtain the appropriate authorisation for invoices where required.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate and resolve discrepancies.
- Liaise with internal departments and external suppliers to resolve invoice queries.
- Ensure invoices are processed promptly and suppliers are paid within agreed terms.
- Process employee expenses
- Assist with weekly payment runs when required.
- Produce monthly corporate card reports and reconcile outstanding items.
- Post bank statements on a daily basis.
- Support month-end procedures and financial reporting.
- Maintain a smooth flow of invoices through the ERP accounting system and prevent processing backlogs.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience working within an Accounts Payable environment.
- Good Excel skills, including experience with Pivot Tables.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong communication and organisational skills.
- Ability to manage a busy workload and meet deadlines.
- Experience dealing with supplier queries and reconciliations.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Accounts Payable professional looking for a 6-month contract within a well-established Wirral-based organisation.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Salary: Circa £28,000 FTE

Permanent Full-time or potentially part-time

Experienced in Credit Control? Looking for a fresh opportunity?

Hoot Recruit is recruiting on behalf of an established business looking for a Credit Controller to join its finance team.

We're looking for someone who knows their way around credit control, enjoys dealing with customers and is confident chasing payments while maintaining good working relationships.

You'll be joining an experienced team, working alongside an existing Credit Controller who will be on hand to provide guidance and support as they move into another position within the business.

What you'll be doing
- Managing outstanding customer payments
- Contacting customers by phone and email to chase overdue invoices
- Maintaining accurate records of payments and outstanding balances
- Resolving invoice and payment queries
- Building positive relationships with customers
- Reconciling customer accounts
- Working closely with the wider finance team to keep debtor balances under control

What we're looking for
- Previous credit control experience is essential
- Confident and professional telephone manner
- Comfortable having conversations about overdue payments
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- Friendly, approachable and proactive attitude

What's on offer?
- Salary circa £28,000 (pro rata for part-time)
- Permanent opportunity
- Potential flexibility around working hours
- Part-time hours may be considered, ideally spread across five days
- Support from an experienced finance team
- Stable, established business

This could be a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller who wants a role where they can make a real contribution without necessarily having to manage a team.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
As a Purchase Ledger professional in Wirral, you will manage purchase ledger tasks that help the Accounting & Finance department keep supplier records and payments organised. Working in the FMCG, Fast Moving Consumer Goods industry, you will help maintain clear and accurate financial information during this temporary assignment.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the FMCG, Fast Moving Consumer Goods industry on the Wirral.

Description
- Process supplier invoices accurately and keep purchase ledger records up to date.
- Match invoices to relevant purchase information and resolve basic discrepancies.
- Maintain supplier account details to support accurate payment records.
- Prepare purchase ledger information for payment processing.
- Respond to supplier queries and provide clear updates on account information.
- Review outstanding invoice items and follow up where further details are needed.
- Keep finance records well organised to support day-to-day Accounting & Finance activity.

Profile

A successful 'Purchase Ledger' should have:
- Experience handling purchase ledger records and supplier invoices.
- Confidence matching invoices with purchase information and checking details.
- Ability to maintain accurate data across supplier accounts.
- Experience dealing with invoice queries in a clear and timely way.
- Good attention to detail when reviewing financial documents.
- Ability to organise workload and keep records up to date.

Job Offer
- Temporary Purchase Ledger assignment.
- Location: Wirral.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk 6mth FTC
description:
Accounts Payable Clerk / Salary £28,000 + Benefits + Free Parking / Bromborough/ 6 Month FTC / Fast Paced Growing Business / Flexible working

Accounts Payable Clerk Benefits
- Salary £28,000
- Hybrid Flexible working
- Free Parking
- Enhanced Holidays 25 days plus Bank holidays (Pro Rata)

NC Associates is partnering with a leading manufacturing business. They're looking for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join their finance team on a 6-month FTC. This is a great opportunity to get stuck into a busy ledger function in a company where your work genuinely keeps the business moving.

Accounts Payable Clerk Key Responsibilities:
- Matching of supplier invoices on SAP to receipted purchase orders set up in the SRM purchasing system. Prices and quantity must be checked to ensure invoice is valid.
- Obtaining correct authorisation where necessary as per the authority schedule/external audit requirements.
- Required to reconcile supplier statements and resolve any differences as per schedule including validating associated GRIR and registered invoice entries, following up with suppliers on any omissions and determining the reason for any discrepancies.
- Ensure that any issues that require resolution in other departments/sites are clearly communicated in a timely manner with colleagues.
- Ensure payment of invoices to terms by regular review and follow up of queries with internal and external contracts.
- Ensure that VAT shown on invoices is correct.
- Ensure expense claims are processed, a good knowledge of excel is required to complete this.
- Advising functional head of any accounts on stop and any major problems with suppliers so appropriate action can be taken.
- Responsible for ensuring that all invoices received in a day are processed by the end of that day.
- Act as a backup for producing and processing the weekly payment run as necessary.
- Responsible for producing the monthly Barclaycard report for Corporate Card Holders, a good knowledge of Excel and Pivot Tables is required.
- Daily posting of the bank statements
- Involvement in month end closing routines and assistance with financial reporting.
- Ensure smooth flow of invoices on the SAP system to prevent backlogs and avoid disruption to supplies of goods/services.

Accounts Payable Clerk Experience:
- Experience with SAP
- Experience working within Accounts Payable
- Good knowledge of Excel

What's on Offer?

This is a fantastic opportunity to work for a growing organisation that can offers various areas of development amongst working within an excellent environment. Please apply for immediate consideration or call

We are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all applicants of identity, personal characteristics, or background.

title: Purchase Ledger Controller
description:
Adaptable Recruitment are exciting to be working with a growing business based on the Wirral who is looking to recruit a high calibre Purchase Ledger Controller to join their team.

Salary and Benefits
Up to £35,000 per annum
25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays
Office based - 37.5 hours per week
Free parking on site

Key Responsibilities
- Take ownership of the Purchase Ledger function, overseeing the accurate and timely processing of supplier invoices and credit notes.
- Manage and support the Purchase Ledger Function, ensuring workloads are prioritised and deadlines are met.
- Oversee supplier statement reconciliations and the resolution of outstanding queries.
- Proactively escalate issues relating to missing purchase orders, proof of delivery (PODs), identified by the team and challenge invoice discrepancies and outstanding approvals.
- Responsible for general house keeping and keeping the aged creditors up to date.
- Work closely with project managers and operational teams to ensure supporting documentation is received and issues are resolved promptly.
- Review outstanding purchase orders and Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI) balances, ensuring these are investigated and cleared where appropriate.
- Take responsibility for Purchase Ledger month-end procedures, including reviewing outstanding invoices and identifying required accruals for Materials.
- Ensure financial controls and purchasing procedures are consistently followed across the business.
- Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and the overall efficiency of the Purchase Ledger function.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in a senior Purchase Ledger, Accounts Payable or supervisory role.
- Experience within construction, or a similar project-based environment would be advantageous but not essential
- Good understanding of Purchase Ledger accounting, particularly accruals, GRNI and month-end cut-off procedures.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, high volume business
- Good Excel skills and experience using accounting software, ideally Sage 50.
- A proactive, hands-on approach with strong attention to detail and a sense of ownership.
